prerequisites: Completion of Psychology of Education, Pedagogy I, Pedagogy II, Didactics of the Specialization courses.
Learning outcomes specific to Psychology of Education, Pedagogy I, Pedagogy II, Didactics of the Specialization courses.

learning_outcomes.text: Knows, understands and uses specialized language.
Knows and uses learning and lesson delivery models with the help of the computer.
Correlates specialized, psycho-pedagogical knowledge in carrying out instructional-educational activities in education and other educational activities with the help of the computer.
Argues the formative potential of theories, principles, and practices specific to the field.
Creates lessons, tutorials, simulations, etc. using the computer.
Builds authentic learning contexts, in an integrated manner, in which students leverage their life experiences and cognitive interests.
Executes professional tasks responsibly, under conditions of restricted autonomy and qualified assistance.
Develops creative and constructive attitudes in applying the principles of computer-assisted instruction.
Indicates the necessity of using varied resources for efficient teaching, supporting learning, and helping students in their autonomous use.
Communicates effectively by providing constructive feedback and supports active student involvement in their own learning process.

syllabus_topics: Computer-assisted instruction. Brief history, definition, terminology. Introduction of technology in school and computer-assisted instruction. Advantages and disadvantages. Examples of distance learning projects.

Learning and lesson delivery models with the help of the computer. Tutorials, exercises, simulations, educational games, Web sites. Information technology used for their design. The open classroom and network learning model. Videoconferencing and online instruction.
Educational programs, virtual universities, distance learning projects, Web publications for (self)instruction. Performance achieved with online courses.
Historical overview of the Internet. The concept of hypertext. Information retrieval on the Web using search engines. Educational portals.

Designing Web pages and tutorials. Components of an educational Web page. Principles of organization and design. Using Istpage and FrontPage Express applications for creating Web pages. Designing an online course. Material presentation, organizing a discussion forum, collecting answers to questions.
Education and the cybersecurity insecurity paradigm. Cyber citizenship. Psychology of social engineering.

Computer-assisted evaluation/examination methods. Multiple-choice tests with unique/multiple answers, having equal/different weights. Questionnaire-type tests. Realization of projects or presentations on the computer.
Presentation of the CAI laboratory and safety instructions for work in the laboratory.
Text processing. Working technique. Microsoft PowerPoint presentation - program presentation and working mode.
Microsoft EXCEL - using the program in spreadsheet applications (data recording and processing in tabular form).
Realization of a tutorial/simulation in the field of specialization.
Microsoft Front Page - program presentation, creation of an educational website.
Integration of social engineering psychology into the curriculum.
assessment_rules: The minimum final grade for passing the course is 5.
